test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The Tagore House __is rehearsing a skit__ for the school's Annual Day Function.
solution:
The correct answer is: **No improvement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**is rehearsing**" is in the present continuous tense, which is appropriate for describing an ongoing action that is happening now.
 
• Therefore, **the sentence is both grammatically and conceptually correct** as it is.

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**has been rehearsing a skits**" is **incorrect **as "skits" should be singular.
 
• Option 2: "**was rehearse a skit**" is **incorrect **as it uses the past tense of the verb "rehearse" instead of the present continuous tense.
 
• Option 3: "**is rehearsed an skit**" is **incorrect **as it uses the present simple passive tense instead of the present continuous tense.
